items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-07-21
items.q: my Uncle William Thornton, he was a carpenter... he became his best customer somewhere in time

ctx.x: They'll come back to us and we can answer the question. Sure. So, specifically, was there anything in school you were terribly interested in, any subjects that you were on? Did you excel there?

Well, you see, my mother and father were not highly educated people, but even though my mother was a very good piano player, and she did domestic work on the side, but she learned how to play the piano because my father was paying the rate when they were living together, and after being separated, well, things started changing in the household. You see, then again, I think my Uncle William and them, they were some of the ones that was partly financing my mother. See, my Uncle William Thornton, he was a carpenter,…
So, as I can answer the question, were you very motivated in school?
